P-ORDER.en: Drag them into the right order.

P-CONNECT.en: Draw a line to each match.

P-DRAG.en: Drag each picture to its match.

P-MATCH-FAMILY.en: Connect each fact to its partner.

P-SORT.en: Drag each into the right basket.

FB-DONTKNOW.en: That's okay. Let's look at it together: {model}

FB-NO-COUNT.id: Belum tepat. Hitung pelan-pelan sambil menunjuk satu per satu. {model}
FB-NO-COUNT.en: Not quite. Count slowly and point at each one. {model}

FB-NO-TENS.id: Belum tepat. Lihat angka puluhannya dulu, baru satuannya. {model}
FB-NO-TENS.en: Not quite. Look at the tens first, then the ones. {model}

FB-NO-ESTIMATE.id: Belum terlalu dekat, tetapi menebak itu latihan yang bagus! {model}
FB-NO-ESTIMATE.en: Not that close yet, but guessing is great practice! {model}

FB-NO-MAKE10.id: Belum tepat. Coba genapkan jadi 10 dulu, lalu tambah sisanya. {model}
FB-NO-MAKE10.en: Not quite. Try making 10 first, then add what's left. {model}

FB-NO-SUB.id: Belum tepat. Mulai dari bilangan yang besar, lalu hitung mundur. {model}
FB-NO-SUB.en: Not quite. Start from the bigger number and count back. {model}

FB-NO-REGROUP.id: Belum tepat. Jumlahkan satuannya dulu. Kalau lebih dari 9, tukar 10 satuan dengan 1 puluhan. {model}
FB-NO-REGROUP.en: Not quite. Add the ones first. If you get more than 9, swap 10 ones for 1 ten. {model}

FB-NO-BORROW.id: Belum tepat. Kalau satuan yang atas lebih kecil, pinjam 1 puluhan dulu. {model}
FB-NO-BORROW.en: Not quite. If the top ones digit is smaller, borrow 1 ten first. {model}

FB-NO-SHAPE.id: Belum tepat. Yuk, hitung sisi dan sudutnya pelan-pelan. {model}
FB-NO-SHAPE.en: Not quite. Let's count the sides and corners slowly. {model}

FB-NO-MEASURE.id: Belum tepat. Bandingkan dari garis awal yang sama. {model}
FB-NO-MEASURE.en: Not quite. Compare them from the same starting line. {model}

FB-NO-BALANCE.id: Belum tepat. Sisi timbangan yang lebih berat turun ke bawah. {model}
FB-NO-BALANCE.en: Not quite. The heavier side of a balance goes down. {model}

FB-NO-CLOCK.id: Belum tepat. Jarum pendek menunjukkan jam, jarum panjang menunjukkan menit. {model}
FB-NO-CLOCK.en: Not quite. The short hand shows the hour and the long hand shows the minutes. {model}

FB-NO-HALF.id: Belum tepat. Saat jarum panjang di angka 6, jarum pendek ada di antara dua angka. Lihat angka yang baru dilewatinya. {model}
FB-NO-HALF.en: Not quite. When the long hand is on 6, the short hand sits between two numbers. Look at the one it has just passed. {model}

FB-NO-CALENDAR.id: Belum tepat. Coba sebutkan urutannya pelan-pelan dari awal. {model}
FB-NO-CALENDAR.en: Not quite. Try saying them in order, slowly, from the start. {model}

FB-NO-MONEY.id: Belum tepat. Jumlahkan nilai uangnya satu per satu, ya. {model}
FB-NO-MONEY.en: Not quite. Add up the money one piece at a time. {model}

FB-NO-CHANGE.id: Belum tepat. Kembalian = uang yang dibayar − harga. {model}
FB-NO-CHANGE.en: Not quite. Change = money paid − price. {model}

FB-NO-SKIP.id: Belum tepat. Coba hitung loncat sampai tujuanmu. {model}
FB-NO-SKIP.en: Not quite. Try skip counting until you reach the goal. {model}

FB-NO-PATTERN.id: Belum tepat. Cari dulu bagian yang berulang atau aturan tambahnya. {model}
FB-NO-PATTERN.en: Not quite. First find the part that repeats, or the adding rule. {model}

FB-NO-EVEN.id: Belum tepat. Bilangan genap berakhiran 0, 2, 4, 6, atau 8. {model}
FB-NO-EVEN.en: Not quite. Even numbers end in 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8. {model}

FB-NO-POS.id: Belum tepat. Lihat lagi letaknya pelan-pelan. {model}
FB-NO-POS.en: Not quite. Take another slow look at where it is. {model}

FB-NO-LR.id: Belum tepat. Kiri dan kanan dilihat dari arah kamu memandang. {model}
FB-NO-LR.en: Not quite. Left and right are as you look at it. {model}

FB-NO-DATA.id: Belum tepat. Hitung lagi setiap kelompok dengan teliti. {model}
FB-NO-DATA.en: Not quite. Count each group again carefully. {model}

FB-NO-GROUPS.id: Belum tepat. Hitung dulu banyak kelompoknya, lalu isi setiap kelompok. {model}
FB-NO-GROUPS.en: Not quite. First count the groups, then how many are in each one. {model}

FB-NO-SHARE.id: Belum tepat. Bagikan satu per satu secara bergiliran sampai habis. {model}
FB-NO-SHARE.en: Not quite. Hand them out one at a time, taking turns, until none are left. {model}

FB-GEM.id: Permata ini masuk ke Kotak Permatamu.
FB-GEM.en: This gem goes into your Gem box.

FB-READ.id: Bagus, kamu sudah membaca. Sekarang jawab pertanyaannya, ya.
FB-READ.en: Nice reading! Now let's answer the questions.

FB-PUZZLE-NO.id: Hampir! Teka-teki memang perlu dipikirkan pelan-pelan. {model}

body.id: Hitung sambil menunjuk satu per satu. Bilangan terakhir = banyaknya.
body.en: Point at each one as you count. The last number is how many.

body.id: 10 satuan = 1 puluhan. 47 = 4 puluhan dan 7 satuan.
body.en: 10 ones = 1 ten. 47 = 4 tens and 7 ones.

body.id: Membandingkan? Lihat puluhannya dulu: 52 lebih besar dari 25.
body.en: Comparing? Look at the tens first: 52 is bigger than 25.

gloss.id: Pada garis bilangan, 40 ada di antara 39 dan 41.
gloss.en: On the number line, 40 sits between 39 and 41.

body.id: Menambah = menggabungkan: 8 + 5 = 13.
body.en: Adding = putting together: 8 + 5 = 13.

body.id: Trik: genapkan jadi 10 dulu. 8 + 2 = 10, sisa 3, jadi 13.
body.en: Trick: make 10 first. 8 + 2 = 10, 3 left, so 13.

body.id: Mengurangi = mengambil: 13 − 5 = 8. Keduanya bersaudara!
body.en: Subtracting = taking away: 13 − 5 = 8. They're a family!

body.id: Atap seperti segitiga, matahari seperti lingkaran.
body.en: A roof is like a triangle, the sun like a circle.

body.id: Segitiga: 3 sisi, 3 sudut. Persegi: 4 sisi sama panjang. Lingkaran: tanpa sudut.
body.en: Triangle: 3 sides, 3 corners. Square: 4 equal sides. Circle: no corners.

body.id: Bangun ruang bisa dipegang: kubus (dadu), tabung (kaleng), bola.
body.en: Solids you can hold: cube (dice), cylinder (tin can), sphere (ball).

gloss.id: Tabung: bisa menggelinding dan bisa berdiri
gloss.en: Cylinder: it can roll and it can stand up

body.id: Mengukur = membandingkan: lebih panjang, lebih berat.
body.en: Measuring = comparing: longer, heavier.

body.id: Jengkal tiap orang berbeda, jadi kita pakai cm (penggaris) dan kg (timbangan).
body.en: Hand spans differ, so we use cm (ruler) and kg (scale).

body.id: Mengukur dengan penggaris? Mulai dari angka 0.
body.en: Measuring with a ruler? Start at 0.

gloss.id: lebih panjang ↔ lebih pendek; lebih berat ↔ lebih ringan
Penggaris panjang di sekolah biasanya 30 cm.
gloss.en: A long school ruler is usually 30 cm.

body.id: Jarum pendek = jam, jarum panjang = menit. Jarum panjang di 12: jam tepat.
body.en: Short hand = hour, long hand = minutes. Long hand on 12: on the hour.

body.id: Jarum panjang di 6: setengah. Pukul 07.30 = setengah delapan.
body.en: Long hand on 6: half past. 7:30 is setengah delapan ('half to eight').

body.id: 1 minggu = 7 hari. 1 tahun = 12 bulan.
body.en: 1 week = 7 days. 1 year = 12 months.

gloss.id: Pukul 09.00: jarum pendek di 9, jarum panjang di 12.
gloss.en: 9 o'clock: short hand on 9, long hand on 12.

gloss.id: Pukul 04.30: jarum pendek di antara 4 dan 5, jarum panjang di 6.
gloss.en: 4:30: short hand between 4 and 5, long hand on 6.

body.id: Rupiah: koin (Rp500, Rp1.000) dan uang kertas (Rp2.000, Rp5.000, Rp10.000). Jumlahkan nilainya.
body.en: Rupiah: coins (Rp500, Rp1,000) and notes (Rp2,000, Rp5,000, Rp10,000). Add up the values.

body.id: Bayar Rp5.000 untuk kue Rp3.000: kembaliannya Rp2.000.
body.en: Pay Rp5,000 for a Rp3,000 cake: Rp2,000 change.

body.id: Menabung Rp1.000 sehari, seminggu jadi Rp7.000. Sedikit demi sedikit, lama-lama menjadi bukit.
body.en: Save Rp1,000 a day: Rp7,000 in a week. Little by little, it becomes a hill.

body.id: Pola = susunan yang berulang menurut aturan, seperti motif batik.
body.en: A pattern repeats by a rule, like batik.

body.id: Pola berulang: merah, biru, merah, biru, … Cari bagian yang berulang.
body.en: Repeating: red, blue, red, blue, … Find the part that repeats.

body.id: Pola bertambah: 2, 4, 6, 8, … Genap dibagi dua tanpa sisa; ganjil sisa satu.
body.en: Growing: 2, 4, 6, 8, … Even numbers split in two exactly; odd ones leave one over.

body.id: Kata posisi: di atas, di bawah, di dalam, di samping, di depan, di belakang.
body.en: Position words: above, below, inside, beside, in front, behind.

body.id: Kiri dan kanan pada gambar: dilihat dari arah kamu memandang.
body.en: Left and right in a picture: as you look at it.

body.id: Petunjuk jalan: lurus, belok, berhenti. Berbalik badan = setengah putaran.
body.en: Directions: straight, turn, stop. Turning around = a half turn.

gloss.en: The cat is inside the box.
The roof is above the wall.

body.id: Kelompokkan menurut jenis, warna, atau bentuk, bahkan dua aturan sekaligus.
body.en: Sort by kind, colour or shape, even by two rules at once.

body.id: Turus: 4 garis tegak, garis kelima mencoret. Satu kelompok = 5.
body.en: Tally: 4 lines, the fifth crosses them. One bundle = 5.

body.id: Piktogram: satu gambar = satu anak. Hitung gambarnya.
body.en: Pictograph: one picture = one child. Count the pictures.

body.id: 3 piring, tiap piring 4 kue: 4 + 4 + 4 = 12, ditulis 3 × 4 = 12.
body.en: 3 plates of 4 cakes: 4 + 4 + 4 = 12, written 3 × 4 = 12.

body.id: Barisan juga begitu: 4 baris padi × 5 rumpun = 20 rumpun.
body.en: Rows work the same: 4 rows of 5 rice clumps = 20.

body.id: Bagi rata: 12 rambutan untuk 3 anak, masing-masing 4.
body.en: Share fairly: 12 rambutans for 3 children, 4 each.

gloss.id: Sepuluh kelereng dibagi rata untuk 2 anak: masing-masing mendapat 5.
gloss.en: 10 marbles shared equally between 2 children: 5 each.

body.id: Pagi ini Dina membawa uang Rp5.000 ke warung Bu Tini.
body.en: This morning Dina takes Rp5,000 to Bu Tini's warung.

body.id: Di warung ada roti seharga Rp3.000, susu kotak seharga Rp4.000, dan pisang seharga Rp1.000 per buah.
body.en: The warung has bread for Rp3,000, cartons of milk for Rp4,000, and bananas for Rp1,000 each.

body.id: Dina ingin membeli sarapan. Ia juga ingin menabung Rp2.000 untuk membeli buku cerita.
body.en: Dina wants to buy breakfast. She also wants to save Rp2,000 towards a storybook.

body.id: Bu Guru bertanya, buah apa yang paling kamu sukai? Setiap anak memilih satu buah. Setiap ● berarti satu anak.
body.en: The teacher asked: which fruit do you like best? Each child picked one fruit. Each ● stands for one child.

body.id: Mangga: ● ● ● ● ● ● ●
Pisang: ● ● ● ●
body.en: Banana: ● ● ● ●

body.id: Rambutan: ● ● ● ● ● ●
body.en: Rambutan: ● ● ● ● ● ●

body.id: Pepaya: ● ●
body.en: Papaya: ● ●

body.id: Anak-anak kelas 2A bercerita tentang hewan peliharaan mereka. Setiap ● berarti satu anak.
body.en: The children in Class 2A talked about their pets. Each ● stands for one child.

body.id: Kucing: ● ● ● ● ●
Ayam: ● ● ●
body.en: Chicken: ● ● ●

meaning.en: A full row = 5 mangoes.

model_answer.en: There are 13 mangoes: 5 + 5 + 3.

meaning.en: Which one shows 12 eggs?

model_answer.id: Ada 12 telur: dua baris penuh (10) dan 2 lagi.
model_answer.en: There are 12 eggs: two full rows (10) and 2 more.

meaning.id: Lihat sebentar, jangan dihitung. Kira-kira berapa?
meaning.en: Just a quick look, no counting. About how many?

model_answer.id: Ada 18 kelereng. Tebakan dari 15 sampai 21 sudah hebat!
model_answer.en: There are 18 marbles. Any guess from 15 to 21 is great!

meaning.id: 4 ikat lidi (isi 10) dan 6 lidi lepas. Berapa semuanya?
meaning.en: 4 bundles of 10 sticks and 6 loose sticks. How many altogether?

model_answer.id: Empat puluhan dan enam satuan, jadi 46 lidi.
model_answer.en: Four tens and six ones make 46 sticks.

meaning.id: Dina 38 kelereng, Bimo 83. Siapa lebih banyak?
meaning.en: Dina has 38 marbles, Bimo 83. Who has more?

model_answer.en: Bimo: 83 has 8 tens, 38 has only 3.
The order is 29, 31, 56, 65.

meaning.en: On the number line: 57, 58, __, 60

model_answer.en: 57, 58, 59, 60: each step right adds 1.

meaning.en: 70 is the same as 7 tens.

model_answer.en: 70 really is 7 tens and 0 ones.

meaning.en: Which one shows 17 marbles?

model_answer.en: There are 17 marbles: 5 + 5 + 5 + 2.

meaning.id: Hati-hati: belas dan puluh itu berbeda!
meaning.en: Careful: -teen and -ty are different!

model_answer.id: 14 = empat belas, 40 = empat puluh, 19 = sembilan belas, 91 = sembilan puluh satu.
model_answer.en: 14 = fourteen, 40 = forty, 19 = nineteen, 91 = ninety-one.

meaning.en: What number comes right after 79?

model_answer.id: 79 + 1 = 80. Sepuluh satuan menjadi satu puluhan baru.
model_answer.en: 79 + 1 = 80. Ten ones make a new ten.

meaning.id: 6 kantong kelereng (isi 10) dan 3 kelereng lepas. Berapa semuanya?
meaning.en: 6 bags of 10 marbles and 3 loose marbles. How many altogether?

model_answer.id: Enam puluhan dan tiga satuan, jadi 63 kelereng.
model_answer.en: Six tens and three ones make 63 marbles.

meaning.en: Which number is smaller?

model_answer.id: Bilangan 47 lebih kecil, karena 4 puluhan lebih sedikit daripada 7 puluhan.
model_answer.en: 47 is smaller, because 4 tens are fewer than 7 tens.

items.source: Encyclopaedia Britannica, 'zero' (mathematics) and 'Brahmagupta' (Brahmasphutasiddhanta, 628 CE); Online Etymology Dictionary, entries 'zero' and 'cipher' (from Arabic sifr).

model_answer.id: Dulu, banyak bangsa belum punya bilangan nol! Ahli di India mulai memakai nol, dan sekitar tahun 628 Brahmagupta menulis aturan berhitung dengannya. Kata Arab sifr ('kosong') menjadi asal kata zero dan cipher.
model_answer.en: Long ago, many peoples had no zero! Mathematicians in India began using zero, and around 628 Brahmagupta wrote rules for calculating with it. The Arabic word sifr ('empty') gave English 'zero' and 'cipher'.

meaning.id: Raka punya 8 kelereng, lalu diberi 5 lagi. Jadi berapa?
meaning.en: Raka has 8 marbles and gets 5 more. How many now?
Every addition fact has a subtraction partner.

meaning.id: Ibu memakai 3 telur untuk kue. Sisa berapa?
meaning.en: Mum uses 3 eggs for a cake. How many are left?

model_answer.en: 10 − 3 = 7. There are 7 eggs left.

meaning.id: Bu Ani membuat 14 kue, 6 diberikan ke tetangga. Sisa berapa?
meaning.en: Bu Ani bakes 14 cakes and gives 6 away. How many are left?
Build: baked − given away = left.

model_answer.en: 14 − 6 = 8. There are 8 cakes left.

meaning.id: Ada 36 buku cerita, Pak Guru membawa 27 lagi. Berapa sekarang?
meaning.en: There are 36 storybooks and the teacher brings 27 more. How many now?
There are 52 chairs and 18 are moved. How many are left?

model_answer.en: 15 − 7 isn't 9, it's 8, because 8 + 7 = 15.

meaning.id: Pagi terjual 45 pisang goreng, sore 38. Berapa semuanya?
meaning.en: 45 fried bananas sold in the morning, 38 in the afternoon. How many altogether?

meaning.id: 7 burung, lalu datang 6 lagi. Berapa sekarang?
meaning.en: 7 birds, then 6 more fly in. How many now?

meaning.id: 12 layang-layang terbang, 4 turun. Berapa yang masih terbang?
meaning.en: 12 kites are flying and 4 come down. How many are still flying?

items.source: Florian Cajori, A History of Mathematical Notations, vol. 1 (1928): Johannes Widmann, Behende und hüpsche Rechenung auff allen Kauffmanschafft (Leipzig, 1489) for + and −, Recorde's The Whetstone of Witte (1557) for =; MacTutor History of Mathematics, 'Robert Recorde'.

model_answer.id: Tanda + dan − pertama kali tercetak tahun 1489, di buku berhitung untuk pedagang karya Johannes Widmann dari Jerman. Tanda = muncul tahun 1557: Robert Recorde dari Wales memilih dua garis sejajar karena tidak ada yang lebih sama.
model_answer.en: The + and − signs first appeared in print in 1489, in an arithmetic book for merchants by Johannes Widmann of Germany. The = sign came in 1557: Robert Recorde of Wales chose two parallel lines because nothing could be more equal.

meaning.en: Find the triangle.

model_answer.id: Atap rumah berbentuk segitiga: 3 sisi dan 3 sudut.
model_answer.en: The roof is a triangle: 3 sides and 3 corners.

meaning.en: 4 sides, all the same length.

model_answer.en: A square: all 4 sides are the same length.

meaning.en: How many corners?

model_answer.en: A triangle has 3 corners and 3 sides.

meaning.en: Corners or no corners?

model_answer.id: Punya sudut: segitiga, persegi, persegi panjang. Tidak punya sudut: lingkaran, oval.
model_answer.en: Corners: triangle, square, rectangle. No corners: circle, oval.

meaning.en: Find the circle.

model_answer.id: Matahari digambar berbentuk lingkaran. Lingkaran tidak punya sudut.
model_answer.en: The sun is drawn as a circle. A circle has no corners.

meaning.en: A triangle has 4 sides.

model_answer.id: Segitiga hanya punya 3 sisi. Namanya saja segi-tiga!
model_answer.en: A triangle has only 3 sides. 'Tri' means three!

meaning.en: Which solid is a tin can like?

model_answer.id: Tabung: bagian atas dan bawahnya berbentuk lingkaran, seperti kaleng.
model_answer.en: A cylinder: its top and bottom are circles, just like a tin can.

meaning.en: What is it called? It's shaped like a dice.

model_answer.id: Kubus. Keenam sisinya berbentuk persegi yang sama besar.
model_answer.en: A cube. All six faces are squares of the same size.

meaning.en: Find the square.

model_answer.id: Dinding rumah persegi: 4 sisinya sama panjang.
model_answer.en: The wall is a square: 4 equal sides.

meaning.en: Flat shape or solid shape?

model_answer.id: Bangun datar: lingkaran, persegi, segitiga. Bangun ruang: bola, kubus, kerucut.
model_answer.en: Flat: circle, square, triangle. Solid: sphere, cube, cone.

meaning.id: Papan tulis ini persegi panjang. Berapa sisinya?
meaning.en: This board is a rectangle. How many sides?

model_answer.id: Persegi panjang punya 4 sisi: 2 sisi panjang dan 2 sisi pendek.
model_answer.en: A rectangle has 4 sides: 2 long sides and 2 short sides.

meaning.en: Which one has no corners?

model_answer.id: Oval (bulat telur) tidak punya sudut, sama seperti lingkaran.
model_answer.en: An oval (egg shape) has no corners, just like a circle.

meaning.en: How many corners?

model_answer.id: Persegi punya 4 sudut dan 4 sisi yang sama panjang.
model_answer.en: A square has 4 corners and 4 sides of equal length.

items.source: Encyclopaedia Britannica, 'Möbius strip' (a one-sided surface made by giving a strip a half twist before joining the ends; described by August Ferdinand Möbius in 1858).

model_answer.id: Minta orang dewasa menggunting pita kertas panjang. Putar satu ujungnya setengah putaran, lalu rekatkan kedua ujungnya. Tarik garis di tengah pita tanpa mengangkat pensil: garismu melewati 'kedua' sisi dan kembali ke awal! Pita Möbius ini hanya punya satu sisi.
model_answer.en: Ask a grown-up to cut a long paper strip. Give one end a half twist, then tape the ends together. Draw a line along the middle without lifting your pencil: it covers 'both' sides and comes back to the start! This Möbius strip has only one side.

meaning.en: Which is the longest?

model_answer.id: Pensil yang paling panjang ujungnya paling jauh dari garis awal.
model_answer.en: The longest pencil reaches furthest from the starting line.

meaning.en: Which is heavier?

model_answer.id: Benda di kiri lebih berat, karena piringnya turun.
model_answer.en: The one on the left is heavier, because its pan has gone down.
Short, medium, then long.

meaning.en: About how many cm is a new pencil?

model_answer.id: Kira-kira 18 cm. Tebakan 14–22 cm sudah bagus!
model_answer.en: About 18 cm. Any guess from 14 to 22 cm is good!

meaning.id: Berat beras diukur dengan satuan apa?
meaning.en: Which unit measures the weight of rice?

model_answer.id: Kilogram (kg). Misalnya, Ibu membeli 5 kg beras.
model_answer.en: Kilograms (kg). For example, Mum buys 5 kg of rice.

meaning.id: Satu kilogram kapas lebih ringan daripada satu kilogram besi.
meaning.en: One kilogram of cotton wool is lighter than one kilogram of iron.

model_answer.id: Keduanya sama berat, yaitu 1 kg! Kapas hanya terlihat lebih besar.
model_answer.en: They weigh the same: 1 kg each! The cotton just takes up more space.

meaning.id: Meja Sinta 6 jengkal, meja Dodi 4 jengkal (tangan yang sama). Selisihnya berapa jengkal?
meaning.en: Sinta's table is 6 spans, Dodi's is 4 (same hand). How many spans longer is Sinta's?

model_answer.en: 6 − 4 = 2. Sinta's table is 2 hand spans longer.

model_answer.id: Semut, pensil, pintu kelas, lalu tiang bendera.
model_answer.en: Ant, pencil, classroom door, then flagpole.

meaning.en: Which one is balanced?

model_answer.id: Kalau kedua sisi sama berat, timbangan seimbang dan datar.
model_answer.en: When both sides weigh the same, the balance stays level.

meaning.en: About how many kg is an adult cat?

model_answer.en: About 4 kg (between 3 and 5 kg).

meaning.id: Pita 15 cm dipotong 6 cm. Sisanya berapa cm?
meaning.en: A 15 cm ribbon has 6 cm cut off. How many cm are left?

model_answer.en: 15 cm − 6 cm = 9 cm.

meaning.en: Which is the shortest?

model_answer.id: Pensil yang paling pendek ujungnya paling dekat dengan garis awal.
model_answer.en: The shortest pencil ends closest to the starting line.

meaning.en: Which is lighter?

model_answer.id: Benda di kiri lebih ringan, karena piringnya naik ke atas.

items.source: KBBI daring (kbbi.kemdikbud.go.id), entries 'jengkal', 'hasta' and 'depa'; Vitruvius, De architectura, Book III ch. 1 (outstretched arms measure about the same as a person's height).

model_answer.id: Dulu orang mengukur dengan tubuhnya: jengkal (ibu jari sampai kelingking direntangkan), hasta (siku sampai ujung jari tengah), dan depa (kedua lengan direntangkan). Ukur depamu bersama teman: biasanya hampir sama dengan tinggi badanmu!
model_answer.en: Long ago, people measured with their bodies: the jengkal or hand span (thumb to little finger, stretched), the hasta (elbow to middle fingertip) and the depa (both arms stretched out). Measure your depa with a friend: it's usually almost your height!

items.source: Encyclopaedia Britannica, 'sexagesimal number system' and 'Mesopotamian mathematics'; O. Neugebauer, The Exact Sciences in Antiquity (2nd ed., 1957), on Babylonian base-60 reckoning and its use for time and angles.

model_answer.id: Kenapa satu jam ada 60 menit? Kebiasaan membagi dengan 60 berasal dari Mesopotamia kuno (Sumeria dan Babilonia), lebih dari 4.000 tahun lalu. Bilangan 60 mudah dibagi rata: oleh 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 12, 15, 20, dan 30.
model_answer.en: Why does an hour have 60 minutes? Dividing by 60 comes from ancient Mesopotamia (the Sumerians and Babylonians), over 4,000 years ago. 60 shares out evenly by 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 12, 15, 20 and 30.

items.source: Bank Indonesia, 'Ciri-Ciri Keaslian Uang Rupiah', Uang Rupiah Kertas Tahun Emisi 2016: kode tunanetra (blind code) berupa pasangan garis timbul di sisi kanan dan kiri, berbeda untuk setiap pecahan (bi.go.id).

model_answer.id: Raba pinggir kiri dan kanan uang kertas rupiah: ada garis-garis kecil yang terasa kasar! Namanya kode tunanetra (blind code). Polanya berbeda untuk setiap nilai, sehingga teman tunanetra bisa mengenali uang dengan meraba. Minta izin orang tuamu dulu, ya.
model_answer.en: Feel the left and right edges of a rupiah note: there are small raised lines! It's called a blind code. The pattern is different for each value, so blind people can tell notes apart by touch. Ask a grown-up first.

items.source: Encyclopaedia Britannica, 'palindrome' (a word, verse, sentence or number that reads the same backward or forward).

model_answer.id: Bilangan 121 dibaca sama dari depan dan dari belakang. Bilangan seperti ini disebut palindrom, misalnya 77, 303, dan 1.221. Kalimat juga bisa: baca 'kasur ini rusak' dari belakang, huruf demi huruf!
model_answer.en: 121 reads the same forwards and backwards. Numbers like this are palindromes, such as 77, 303 and 1,221. Sentences can be too: read 'never odd or even' backwards, letter by letter! In Indonesian, try 'kasur ini rusak'.

items.source: Gene Ammarell, Bugis Navigation (Yale University Southeast Asia Studies, 1999); UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage, 'Pinisi, art of boatbuilding in South Sulawesi' (Representative List, inscribed 2017).

model_answer.id: Pelaut Bugis dari Sulawesi Selatan berlayar jauh mengarungi lautan Nusantara. Mereka menentukan arah dengan membaca bintang, angin, dan gelombang. Tahun 2017, UNESCO mengakui seni membuat kapal pinisi dari Sulawesi Selatan sebagai warisan budaya takbenda dunia.
model_answer.en: Bugis sailors from South Sulawesi sailed far across the archipelago. They found their way by reading the stars, the wind and the waves. In 2017, UNESCO recognised the art of building pinisi boats in South Sulawesi as world intangible cultural heritage.

items.source: Royal Belgian Institute of Natural Sciences, 'The Ishango bone' (naturalsciences.be): found in 1950 by Jean de Heinzelin at Ishango, DR Congo, dated to about 20,000 years ago.

items.source: KBBI daring (kbbi.kemdikbud.go.id), entries 'lusin' (dua belas buah) and 'kodi' (satuan hitung barang, terutama kain atau pakaian, yang banyaknya dua puluh).

model_answer.id: Pedagang punya satuan hitung sendiri: satu lusin berisi 12 buah (misalnya selusin piring), satu kodi berisi 20 lembar (biasa untuk kain atau baju). Bilangan 12 enak untuk berbagi: bisa dibagi rata untuk 2, 3, 4, atau 6 anak!
model_answer.en: Traders have their own counting words: a lusin is 12 things (a dozen plates, say) and a kodi is 20 pieces (often cloth or clothes). 12 is great for sharing: it splits evenly between 2, 3, 4 or 6 children!
